Lindenmoor: 2,151,400 cubic metres = 2,151,400,000 litres. Per resident per day: 2,151,400,000 ÷ 29,051 ÷ 365 ≈ 202.9 litres.

Kelmarsh: 1,739 megalitres = 1,739,000,000 litres. Per resident per day: 1,739,000,000 ÷ 24,117 ÷ 365 ≈ 197.6 litres.

Difference: 202.9 − 197.6 = 5.3 litres per resident per day.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 5.3
